speechServer.serverDescription: The local ttsd daemon that runs the speech models. Its config lives in ~/ttsd/server.yaml.
speechServer.offline: Not reachable — start it with: ttsd start
speechServer.modelDescription: Which server model reads the selected text.
speechServer.voiceDescription: Built-in voice of the model, or one of your voice samples.
speechServer.languageDescription: Language of the text being read. Ming speaks German and English without a voice sample.
speechServer.previewDescription: Reads this sentence with the current settings, exactly as the hotkey would.
speechServer.generationDescription: Every setting applies to the next sentence; no restart needed.
speechServer.temperatureDescription: Lower = calmer and more repeatable, higher = livelier but less predictable.
speechServer.seedDescription: One fixed number keeps the same rendering every time. Empty = new random noise for each sentence.
speechServer.lockVoiceDescription: Sends a fixed reference clip of the built-in voice with every sentence, so the speaker does not change between sentences. Turn off to hear the bare voice, which can sound better but may drift.
speechServer.resetKnobsDescription: Clears all sliders above back to the model's own values.

cfg_scale.label: Guidance (cfg_scale)
cfg_scale.description: How strictly Ming follows the text and voice. Model default {{fallback}}.

ddpm_steps.label: Quality steps (ddpm_steps)
ddpm_steps.description: More steps = finer audio but slower. Model default {{fallback}}.

sigma.label: Noise width (sigma)
sigma.description: Variation in the sound. Model default {{fallback}}.

exaggeration.label: Expressiveness (exaggeration)
exaggeration.description: How emotional Chatterbox sounds. Model default {{fallback}}.

cfg_weight.label: Guidance (cfg_weight)
cfg_weight.description: How closely Chatterbox follows the voice sample. Model default {{fallback}}.

repetition_penalty.label: Repetition penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Discourages stuck or repeated sounds. Model default {{fallback}}.

speechServer.samplesDescription: Your own recordings. Ming and Chatterbox can read with any of them.
speechServer.noTranscript: No transcript — cloning works best with the exact text.
speechServer.addSampleDescription: 5–15 seconds of clear speech, one speaker, no music. The transcript must match the recording word for word.
